title: chrysanthemum roborowskii
intro: Chrysanthemum roborowskii, commonly known as Wollemi Chrysanthemum, is a rare and endangered flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving headaches and sore throats, and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum roborowskii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are known to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Furthermore, Chrysanthemum roborowskii has been traditionally used to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality.
